name: Ever Glory United Holdings Limited
summary: Ever Glory United Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, provides mechanical and electrical engineering services for the public and private sectors in Singapore. The company operates through the M&E Engineering Services and Property Development segments. It engages in the installation and maintenance of air conditioning and mechanical ventilation systems; electrical installations, transmission and distribution networks, power supply equipment, and airfield lighting systems; the installation of plumbing, sanitary, and gas systems for buildings; and fire protection alarm systems in infrastructure projects.
